properties.name: Lamplighting
properties.description: Lights any lamp or lantern with a touch; the flame burns without fuel until dawn and cannot be put out by wind, water, or any hand but his. Works only after sunset and before dawn, when solar elevation is below 0°.

properties.name: Cold flame
properties.description: His flames give ordinary lantern light but no heat, and cannot ignite anything.

properties.name: Steady hands
properties.description: He never drops, spills, or fumbles anything he is carrying.

properties.name: Route memory
properties.description: He remembers the position of every lamp on every route he has walked.

properties.name: Night familiarity
properties.description: Moves comfortably through darkness from long habit, with no supernatural sight.

properties.name: Ordinary human
properties.description: Apart from lamplighting, his abilities are those of an ordinary person.

visual_traits.descriptor: stooped, lean, an old walker's gait
weathered and kind, deep smile lines
thin white hair under a flat wool cap
patched brown greatcoat with a lamp hook at the belt
lamp yellow, soot brown, night blue
small warm lights in a row along a dark street

exclusion_candidates.reason: An ordinary habit with no effect on what his flame does
Recall of lamp positions; it does not change what his flame does
